## Requirements

1. The named mutation is declared, scripted, verifiable — and **never
   executed** under `live_verification=false`.
2. The dark `sig-intake` Cloud Run service is a single committed
   declaration (`sig-ops intake-op plan`): `sig-intake-rt`, `sig-api`'s
   serving digest read at apply time (never `:latest`), `--ingress
   internal`, `--no-allow-unauthenticated`, min 0 / max 2, port 8080,
   `SIG_INTAKE_ENABLED=1` + `SIG_PG_DB=sig`, the three secret mounts —
   `SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL` explicitly absent.
3. The e-mail-only dark posture from Q-27/OD-08 [B-8] ("Email, no time
   promises") stands: `[intake].operational=false`, `owner=""`,
   `staffed=false`; the `/intake/*` URL-map rule stays `enabled=false`;
   the `sig-intake` service honestly answers `503 receiver_not_operating`.
4. Two catalog-only DB-login legs (`sig_intake_receiver_login`,
   `sig_intake_reviewer_login`) — least-privilege LOGIN members of their
   NOLOGIN groups; group absent on the spine → apply queues exit 42;
   generated passwords land in Secret Manager only (HG-09).
5. IAM declarations: `sig-intake-rt` + `roles/cloudsql.client` +
   secretAccessor on the three declared secrets; service→identity binding.
6. Privacy/logging: `_Default` exclusion `sig-intake-request-logs` scoped
   by `log_id` to the Cloud Run requests stream alone (IP/user-agent
   platform logs excluded; app stdout/stderr receipt IDs preserved);
   `sig-intake-backend` LB logging declared off — no backend while
   `/intake/*` is disabled. The operating packet honestly discloses
   backups + monthly logical exports may retain intake data — never a
   "no copies" claim.
7. The apply path is windowed and fail-closed: `SIG_EXEC_EARLIEST`,
   daily 03:00–06:30Z freeze, AR-3 batch windows; `SIG_INTAKE_AUTHOR`
   required; no-ADC `--check` prints `PLAN:` + `check OK`; verify reports
   a missing service `UNREAD`/`not_evaluable`, never success.
